comment: Perfboard layout drawn in two alternative versions: a relay-switched board (left, with OMRON G6SU-2 relay and three transistors) and a smaller board without the relay section (right). The left/main relay version is read here; the colour wiring diagram below confirms every value. The right version has only the TL072 section: 100K x3, 1M x2, 560R x2, 100nF x2, 1uF x2, 10uF, 47uF, 1N4001.
